description: Subtle, low‐relief convex linear ridge approximately 1.2 km long, trending NW–SE under closed‐canopy forest. The feature exhibits planar curvature values around +0.003 to +0.005, slopes of less than 1°, and a narrow (5–8 m) crest visible in both hillshade and slope‐derivative layers. In the NIR band it coincides with a line of slightly reduced reflectance (<0.18 normalized), suggesting moisture retention in anthropogenic dark earth. There is no matching feature on the OpenStreetMap layer, and the ridge is too faint and irregular to be a modern skid trail or plantation road.

Shorter, NE–SW trending channel‐like depression about 350 m long and 4–6 m wide. In the curvature map it plots as a concave feature (values –0.004 to –0.006), and hillshade highlights its linear alignment with anomaly_1 at an obtuse intersection. In the visual Sentinel‐2 image it appears as a faint vegetation stress line, and in NIR as a darker band (<0.17) consistent with richer, moisture‐held anthropic soils. It lies entirely within the forest interior and is absent from OSM roads or tracks.
